name: Mariano Mazza
bornNote: Aged THIRTY-SIX when he declared his son Rosario's birth on 2 June 1845, so born about 1809. A BRACCIALE then; 'fu Mariano gia contadino' by his son's death act of 1924. Named in the birth act of 1845, in the marriage act of 1871, in his grandson Salvatore's birth act of 1873 and in Rosario's death act of 1924 -- four records.
spouseNote: Aged THIRTY-SIX at her son Rosario's birth in June 1845, so born about 1809. 'fu Catalano Maria gia casalinga' in 1924. Named in the birth act of 1845, the marriage act of 1871 and the death act of 1924.
source: Piedimonte Etneo, Nati 1845 atto 64; Matrimoni 1871 atto 14; Nati 1873 atto 3; Morti 1924

name: Rosario Mazza
bornNote: BORN TO A DAY. Act 64 of the Piedimonte births of 1845: born at eleven in the morning of 2 JUNE 1845, in the house his parents lived in, and declared by his father Mariano the same day. Aged 28 in January 1873, 31 in 1877, 32 in 1880, 53 in 1898, 55 in 1902, 65 in 1910 and 79 at death -- eight records, one man. A bracciante, later contadino, of Contrada Terremorte, via Grotta Nicodemo and Contrada S. Basilio.
spouseNote: Daughter of GAETANO BONANNO and ANNA CAVALLARO of Piedimonte Etneo, named together in the couple's marriage act. A BRACCIANTE in her own right in 1871. Married Rosario on 30 APRIL 1871, act 14. Still living in 1910, when she and Rosario consented in person to their son Ignazio's marriage.
source: Nati 1845 atto 64; Matrimoni 1871 atto 14; Nati 1873 atto 3; Nati 1877 atto 168; Nati 1880 atto 66; proclamations 1898, 1902, 1910; Morti 1924

name: Salvatore Mazza
bornNote: Born at seven in the morning in Contrada Terremorte, Piedimonte Etneo. NOT 1879, as the family tree has it.
spouseNote: Daughter of Giovanni Nicotra and Venera. Married 25 April 1898 in the parish of Piedimonte Etneo.
source: Nati 1873 atto 3; parish marriage 25 Apr 1898; Morti 1929 atto 9

name: Sebastiano Mazza
bornNote: Piedimonte Etneo. Sailed on the Toscana out of Genoa, 4 October 1949.
spouseNote: Of Briatico. Buried beside him at Nudgee, plots V-1026 and V-1027.

name: Mia Josephine Mazza and Rocco Francesco Mazza
spouseNote: The two children this archive is for.
